run_gif_maker_cli: run the gif maker script with --traj-path and --out-path to generate animated GIFs from trajectory files
run_parallelized_generation: run parallelized image and GIF generation from a trajectory file using multiple worker processes
run_pov_from_atoms: run POV-Ray rendering of atomic structures with adsorbate-surface separation and bond visualization
run_get_parser: run the argument parser to get CLI options for traj-path, out-path, and num-workers
run_gif_from_trajectory: run the script to convert ASE trajectory files into animated GIFs using ffmpeg and POV-Ray
